payload.summary: Main/Reviewer accepts PR #824 only as the bounded benchmark-switch attribution/reporting correction on exact head e29c2bb15e1175635e5b578f4dc7fab5819360c0. The diff preserves completed original-model probes across ordinary partner/return failures, reports catalog/stage identities, leaves incomplete switching as n/a, and continues to rethrow critical resource exceptions. Exact-head cross-platform CI and four focused regressions pass. This approval does not accept or resolve RAM stability, trim15/resource-guard behavior, Vulkan behavior, GGUF/cache binding, model policy, or physical S24 FE runtime stability.
